native_transaction.boundary: PEP-style request submission -> PDP evaluation -> XACML response
native_transaction.n1_locator: N1 data-flow model (frozen stripped-text lines 1755-1784): PEP sends the native request to the context handler; the handler constructs the request context and sends it to the PDP; the PDP evaluates and returns the response context; the handler returns the response to the PEP. Glossary: Context handler (line 931), PDP (line 1007), PEP (line 1016).

wrapper.construction_rule: Copy the frozen original request byte-identically except for inserting exactly one subject Attribute (Category access-subject, AttributeId urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:2.0:conformance-test:some-attribute, DataType xsd:string) carrying the world-specific value. No authorization logic is performed by the wrapper.
